query_analysis.original_query: In our distillation column, there’s concern over potential leakage of corrosive materials. What safety protocols should we implement during shutdown maintenance?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Identify and develop appropriate safety protocols to prevent and manage potential leakage of corrosive materials during shutdown maintenance of a distillation column, ensuring the protection of personnel and compliance with regulatory standards.

selected_agents.role: Design and recommend safety protocols for shutdown maintenance
Assess maintenance procedures and integrate safety protocols into operations
Provide technical insight on distillation column components and potential leakage points

communication_strategy.information_flow: Integration of safety protocols with maintenance procedures and technical specifications
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Collaborative development and validation of safety measures

clarification_questions: What specific corrosive materials are present in your distillation column?
Are there existing safety protocols currently in place during shutdown maintenance?
Can you provide details on known leakage points or areas of concern within the distillation column?
